description: This PHP class 'WorkflowStateModel' represents a model in an API schema for workflow states, encapsulating a workflow state machine and providing a method to convert it into an array for serialization purposes.

classes.name: WorkflowStateModel
classes.description: A model class implementing 'Normalizable' that converts a workflow state machine into an associative array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a specific 'WorkflowStateMachine' instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the workflow state machine into an array with 'action' and 'name' properties for serialization.
